layouts.global_app_layout: Sidebar navigation (left) + Main Content Area (right) typical of DAWs and Creative SaaS.
layouts.song_studio: Bento Grid layout. Left column for inputs (Genre, Language, Mood), right large column for AI generated output (Lyrics and Chords).
layouts.generated_song_view: Split pane: 60% Lyrics with section highlights (Verse, Chorus) and 40% Chords sheet.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8 on cards. Keep inputs breathing.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl on the sticky header and floating player/audio placeholder controls.
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Apply a subtle glowing border to the 'Generate Song' button and the active AI generation area.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a very subtle noise overlay to the dark background to prevent it from looking completely flat.

components.forms_inputs: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Slider (for energy/tempo), Textarea. Do NOT use native HTML inputs.
components.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs to switch between 'Letra' (Lyrics) and 'Cifras' (Chords).
components.buttons: Pill-shaped, using primary accent color with hover lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow-lg.
components.audio_stems_placeholder: CRITICAL: Create a visually striking 'Em Breve' (Coming Soon) section at the bottom. It should look like 4 DAW tracks (Vocals, Drums, Bass, Melody) but with a blur effect, a lock icon, and a glass overlay saying 'Geração de Áudio e Stems em Breve'.

motion_interactions.streaming_text: When AI is generating lyrics, use a typewriter or sequential fade-in effect to simulate streaming.
motion_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and song cards MUST have hover states. Song cards in Library should slightly scale up or show a 'Play' overlay on hover.
motion_interactions.toasts: Use Sonner for success/error states (e.g., 'Música salva na biblioteca').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application texts primarily in Portuguese as the user explicitly asked: 'Quero uma IA especifico só para criar Músicas'.
Implement the UI as a modern, dark-themed SaaS dashboard suitable for music producers.
In the Song Studio, provide clear dropdowns for Estilos (Trap, Pop, EDM, RnB) and Idiomas (Português, Inglês, Espanhol).
For the lyrics section, format the output to clearly show structures like [Verso 1], [Refrão], [Ponte].
Ensure the 'Audio/Stems' feature is highly visible but clearly marked as a placeholder/upcoming feature with locked tracks.
Include a My Library (Minha Biblioteca) view that lists saved songs in a grid layout.
universal_guidelines: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for testing.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., 'transition: all'). Target specific properties.
Avoid generic centered layouts for the main app. Align left for reading, use grids for structure.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, modals, or fixed headers. Always use solid or glassmorphism (bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur).
Ensure hover states and focus rings are distinct and accessible.
Install and use 'sonner' for toast notifications.
